251913|8622dd6f.name: Aedi Thriceforged
251913|8622dd6f.text: You're not bad, but let me show you a few tricks you might find handy.

251964|caa7ddf7.name: Blademaster Ren
251964|caa7ddf7.text: The $c who flinches is the $c who dies. If you would look death in the face as a $c, I will teach you how not to flinch.

252373|e154a23f.name: Anathamaas Aetherwind
252373|e154a23f.text: The followers of the old Highborne ways have never been more hungry to gain knowledge and reclaim what we've lost. If you would seek to wield the power of the arcane and have the aptitude, I can help you take your next steps.

252377|caa7ddf7.name: Seena Skybreaker
252377|caa7ddf7.text: The $c who flinches is the $c who dies. If you would look death in the face as a $c, I will teach you how not to flinch.

254088|caa7ddf7.name: Corsan Earthrazer
254088|caa7ddf7.text: The $c who flinches is the $c who dies. If you would look death in the face as a $c, I will teach you how not to flinch.

254100|1ab538e5.name: Zephras Citizen
254100|1ab538e5.text:
The Al'Aketh cult is becoming a major problem and the peacekeepers seem powerless to stop them. We can only hope that the Windshapers and the High Order can put aside their bickering and work with the peacekeepers to protect us.

I certainly don't want to join a cult!

254149|f642f017.name: Sirocca "Swimmers" Starfeather
254149|f642f017.text:
<The $r before you sways unsteadily, clearly very inebriated.>

I used to be a sailor, you know? Before the trouble started. The skycutters used to run between the islands. Now it's unsafe or some such, or so they say.

I see the High Order and the Windshapers have their skycutters running again, but I'm stuck here, grounded!

What aren't we being told!

<He turns and yells loudly at the innkeeper.>

WHAT AREN'T WE BEING TOLD, DONAAL!?

254411|4ef1d72e.name: Quel'dora Quickgale
254411|4ef1d72e.text: Ah friend, I only help hunters and their pets.

257008|358b7a1a.name: Baelann Swiftcurrent
257008|358b7a1a.text: Re, y ealdor Regenthor. Hir ras novaedi re uden va y vandar thorniss? Melka E gol ruff ras y garde va vil?

257019|c65683ed.name: Nyassa Swiftdraught
257019|c65683ed.text: Winds tidings. What can I help you with?

257022|4fed1ed6.name: Messana Crestwind
257022|4fed1ed6.text:
You might think that just because we live on a floating island, there would be no need for miners like me. After so many thousands of years however, we still manage to dig up a lot of interesting things. 

It's almost like there's some invisible force, constantly creating new mineral deposits every so often. That's magic for you though, right?

Regardless, if you need training as a miner them I'm your shen'dorei.

258130|c2f6629b.name: Jorel Windsinger
258130|c2f6629b.text:
<Before you lies the corpse Jorel Windsinger.

Deep lacerations are cut into his legs, and lightning burns scorch his fur.

It is clear he put up a fight before succombing to his wounds.>

259013|6750d3f2.name: Resaan Nimbuswalker
259013|6750d3f2.text:
<Before you lies a $r; his body is mangled and bruised but still recognizable. It is clear he met a gruesome end while attempting to flee.

It appears that all of his belongings are still on his body, and a half-filled crate nearby lies spilled on the ground.>

265756|0cf2d0bd.name: Genn Fairweather
265756|0cf2d0bd.text:
Welcome to Fairweather Stables! I would love to provide you one of our fine galestriders, but it seems like you may not yet have enough experience to ride one.

They are temperamental at times and are prone to toss newer riders if not handled correctly. I would be more than happy to provide the training for you once you are a more seasoned adventurer and have enough coin!

272045|5a3e1b84.name: Brother Zendraas
272045|5a3e1b84.text:
Why are you looking at me like that. Do you expect me to shoot bolts of lightning at you, or threaten you with the wrath of the Windlord?

Its fair enough if you do. However, not all of us are quite so... zealous.

272045|d5d1dc84.name: Brother Zendraas
272045|d5d1dc84.text:
Tailor, by trade. 

Here stranger, I'll tell you what. Bring me any spare windstones you come across and I'll share my wares with you. I've got quite the stockpile of Al'Aketh garments here. Say what you will about the insanity of the cult, you've got to admit, they have some sense of style.

Or rather, I do, considering I designed most of their attire.

272045|fac7c2e1.name: Brother Zendraas
272045|fac7c2e1.text:
Not much story to tell. I lived in Falaath Village and when the cult moved in, I saw the winds turning. I shaved my head, donned the grey robes, and said the words they wanted to hear. 

Now I'm just trying to survive. Mostly I keep my head down and ply my trade for that crackpot, Lorthuna.

92532-accept.name: Rorian the Dayseeker
92532-accept.text:
While you were gone our $c trainer--Blademaster Ren--requested that we send you their way when you returned. She dropped this note off for you as well.

Give it a read, then find Blademaster Ren inside the village watchtower.
92532-accept.title: The Warrior's Path

92532-complete.name: Blademaster Ren
92532-complete.text:
You are about to embark upon a dangerous journey. Our world is changing and it will need those who have the will to lead and protect others if our people hope to survive. As you grow in power you will need guidance. Come to me--I will do what I can to train you as you progress.

Good luck, $N, may the winds guide you.
92532-complete.title: The Warrior's Path

92532-progress.name: Blademaster Ren
92532-progress.text: So you've come for training, then?
92532-progress.title: The Warrior's Path

92643-complete.name: Dead Cultist
92643-complete.text: <This man is clearly dead, killed by the assassins that you fought outside the house. As you kneel down to inspect the body you notice the glinting reflection of something shiny...>
92643-complete.title: The Turncoat

92644-accept.name: Dead Cultist
92644-accept.text: <You reach beneath the still-warm body of the turncoat cultist and recover a small, glowing blue crystal. It appears to be damaged, but it may still be important. High Elder Shadowsong may be interested in this.>
92644-accept.title: Unfortunate News

92693-progress.name: Aamelia Windfield
92693-progress.text: There's not enough stormapples in skywall to repay you for this.
92693-progress.title: Standing Our Ground

93736-complete.name: Endaria Mistgaze
93736-complete.text:
Handling these essences fills me with a sense of... deep disquiet. I can almost feel a malevolent, regretful aura emanating from them. It's enough to make me faint.

<Endaria shudders slightly.>

I do not look forward to studying these further.
93736-complete.title: Unwelcome Spirits

93736-progress.name: Endaria Mistgaze
93736-progress.text: Shadowgale Forest is a dangerous place. Some even say it's haunted. I'm quite sure that I don't believe that, but I do know that it's not for the faint hearted, or the unprepared.
93736-progress.title: Unwelcome Spirits

93926-complete.name: Peacekeeper Vaaniel
93926-complete.text: <The body here is somewhat fresh, clearly only recently having been killed. Judging by the burns and scorch marks on this peacekeeper's skin, its clear that they were killed by the cult's storm-wielding spellcasters.>
93926-complete.title: The Western Watch

93927-accept.name: Peacekeeper Vaaniel
93927-accept.text: <As you inspect the body of the dead peacekeeper, a bloody note falls free of his hands. Picking it up and reading it may give you a clue as to how to proceed from here.>
93927-accept.title: A Last Request

94003-accept.name: Seena Skybreaker
94003-accept.text:
I am all that remains of the line of Skybreakers here on Zephras Isle. The rest were murdered by the Al'Aketh.

The only thing that outweighs my sorrow is my shame. My family's ancestral shield--the Skybreaker Bulwark--is now in the hands of a cultist named Zaal Stormshield. Family lore holds no harm may befall a worthy wielder of this shield.

Zaal is not worthy, of that I am sure. Find this man at the Shrine of Akir and reclaim my shield from him. Do this and I will teach you the Skybreaker Defense.
94003-accept.title: The Skybreaker Bulwark

94003-complete.name: Seena Skybreaker
94003-complete.text:
You have done what I could not and restored my family honor. For this, I will bestow a gift that few on Zephras are worthy to receive. I will teach out the secrets of the Skybreaker Defense.

Also, you will need a shield to put what I have to teach you into practice. Please, take this one. I have little use for it now that the Skybreaker Bulwark has been returned to me.

Banu'Adoraah, friend.
94003-complete.title: The Skybreaker Bulwark

94489-complete.name: Elegael Thornpaw
94489-complete.text:
<Elegael's face pales as you relay the fate of Jorel and the condition of the rest of the druids.>

No... no! This is far worse than I had--

<Elegael chokes back a sob, and grits her teeth letting out a pained snarl.>

They will pay. They will ALL pay. Anyone who allies with the Al'aketh will feel my wrath! This I swear.
94489-complete.title: The Wounds of Betrayal

94568-progress.name: Talaanis Shadowsong
94568-progress.text: That turncoat risked everything to escape the cult and bring us this crystal...
94568-progress.title: The Cult's True Plans

94896-complete.name: Ealaane Nimbuswalker
94896-complete.text: Thank you, $c, you have done a great kindness to us refugees this day. I will make sure to return these to their owners. At least it gives us a place to start over from.
94896-complete.title: Aid For The Refugees

94896-progress.name: Ealaane Nimbuswalker
94896-progress.text: So many of us left with nothing more than the clothes on our backs. Any belongings you might recover would be cherished.
94896-progress.title: Aid For The Refugees

94897-complete.name: Ealaane Nimbuswalker
94897-complete.text:
<Ealaane's eyes well with tears.>

Oh, Resaan my love. What will become of us now? There was so much... it feels as if our lives together had just started.

Thank you, $c. The world is cruel to take both my home and my love from me. At least his heirloom will give me some closure.
94897-complete.title: The Fate of a Loved One

94897-progress.name: Ealaane Nimbuswalker
94897-progress.text: Have you any news of Resaan? Please, $c, the wait is hard to endure after everything that has happened.
94897-progress.title: The Fate of a Loved One

96646-progress.name: Zerril Softbreeze
96646-progress.text: A good campfire is the foundation to any good camp.
96646-progress.title: Camping 101: Cooking

97964-accept.name: Raan Wildwind
97964-accept.text:
So, you've become a Blacksmith. That's a great choice if you want to make sure your blades never dull.

I reckon I know someone that can help with that by teaching you how to craft a Sharpening Wheel. Bring one of these out at your camp and all the warriors and rogues in the area will be lining up to hone their weapons.
97964-accept.title: Camping 101: Blacksmithing

97967-complete.name: Fenn Fairweather
97967-complete.text:
There you have it, you can now craft your very own Fish Bowl. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.

Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.
97967-complete.title: Camping 101: Fishing

97970-accept.name: Raan Wildwind
97970-accept.text:
Mining isn't the most glamorous, but it's good honest work and a fine profession for you to explore.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Lodestone for your camp. Build one of these and everyone who wants to swing a sword will be eager to gather round your fire and soak up the extra "oomph" it can provide to increase their combat prowess.
97970-accept.title: Camping 101: Mining
